tagline: Defense-focused REIT owning mission-critical properties near U.S. Government installations
hero_kpi_rationale: The Defense/IT portfolio is the primary driver of the company's business, representing 92.1% of square footage and 90.3% of revenue, with high and stable occupancy reflecting structural demand for properties critical to national security.

kpis.name: Defense/IT Portfolio Occupancy Rate
kpis.explanation: Occupancy rate of the Defense/IT portfolio as of December 31, 2025
kpis.description: The Defense/IT portfolio occupancy rate is a key indicator of demand for mission-critical real estate near U.S. defense installations.
kpis.signal: High and stable occupancy, nine consecutive years above 93%

kpis.name: Tenant Retention Rate
kpis.explanation: Tenant retention rate for the Defense/IT portfolio for the year 2025
kpis.description: Tenant retention rate is a key indicator of tenant satisfaction and portfolio stability, reflecting significant security investments that make relocations difficult.
kpis.signal: 10th consecutive year with retention rate of at least 75%, cash rent increases of 2.7% and straight-line rent increases of 11.0%

kpis.name: Same Property Occupancy Rate
kpis.explanation: Occupancy rate of the same-store pool within the Defense/IT portfolio as of December 31, 2025
kpis.description: Same property occupancy excludes the impact of acquisitions and recent developments, providing a comparable performance measure of the existing property base.
kpis.signal: Average pool increase from 95.9% (2024) to 96.0% annualized, decline in same-store pool due to non-renewals

kpis.name: Development Pipeline
kpis.explanation: Total square footage of properties under development as of December 31, 2025
kpis.description: The development pipeline represents external growth investments to meet strong demand in the Defense/IT portfolio, including pre-leased properties and developments for anticipated future demand.
kpis.signal: 646,000 square feet across 5 properties, 58% pre-leased, expected investment of approximately $233.4 million

kpis.name: Total Portfolio Square Footage
kpis.explanation: Total square footage of the operational portfolio including properties under development as of December 31, 2025
kpis.description: Total portfolio square footage reflects the company's asset base, including 201 operational properties totaling 23.2 million square feet as of December 31, 2025.
kpis.signal: 201 operational properties plus 5 under development, growth through development and acquisition

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Total revenue extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL across the last 8 reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Total revenue of $0.764 Bn for the last fiscal year (FY2025).

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.description: Net income extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL across the last 8 reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Net income of $0.014 Bn for the last fiscal year (FY2021).

kpis.name: Operating Income
kpis.description: Operating income extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL across the last 8 reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Operating income of $0.136 Bn for the last fiscal year (FY2017).

risks.title: Concentration of Tenants with the U.S. Government
risks.score_rationale: The company is highly dependent on the U.S. government and its defense contractors, which represent the vast majority of its revenue. Changes in defense budgets, government funding reductions, or government shutdowns could significantly impact revenue.

risks.title: Economic Downturn and Real Estate Market Conditions
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to general economic risks including reduced demand, rising interest rates, inflation, and unfavorable real estate market conditions that could reduce revenue and increase borrowing costs.

risks.title: Risks Related to Development and Acquisitions
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to development risks including construction cost overruns, delivery delays, and lease-up risks. Acquisitions carry integration risks and potential environmental liabilities.

risks.title: Illiquidity of Real Estate Investments
risks.score_rationale: The company's real estate investments are illiquid, meaning it may have difficulty selling them quickly in the event of liquidity needs or strategic shifts.

risks.title: Environmental and Regulatory Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to environmental laws and regulations that could expose it to cleanup or remediation costs in the event of property contamination.

risks.title: Dependence on Defense Sector Dynamics
risks.score_rationale: While the Defense/IT portfolio benefits from bipartisan support for defense budget increases, changes in defense priorities, program cuts, or geopolitical shifts could affect demand.

risks.title: Competition and Local Market Conditions
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in competitive markets where other commercial real estate owners compete for tenants, which could put downward pressure on rental rates.

ai_positioning.summary: No significant mention of artificial intelligence, machine learning, or related technologies is present in CDP's 10-K filing.
